findings: SURVEY-1 (engine): ZERO audio code exists. `grep -rn AudioContext|createOscillator|createGain|decodeAudioData|new Audio(` across game/src returns NOTHING. No file in game/ has audio/sound/sfx/ambien in its name.
SURVEY-2 (assets): ZERO audio assets on disk. find for mp3/ogg/wav/m4a/opus/webm across the repo (minus node_modules) returns nothing. `audioMB 0` was literally true.

SURVEY-3 (the 'sound' in the engine is not sound): every hit for sound/ in game/src/sim/stealth/* is the STEALTH sound-RADIUS abstraction (detection.js::soundRadius, perception.js hearR, system.js events type:'sound'). It is a perception model with no audio output whatsoever. An agent grepping for 'sound' finds a live, well-instrumented subsystem and can mistake it for audio. It is not.

SURVEY-4 (what data declares): game/data/world/regions.json gives each of 13 regions an `audio` array of 3 identifier strings (39 total, e.g. amb_insect_wall/amb_canopy_drip/sfx_distant_axe) plus a prose `ambient_text`. Nothing reads either. This is the source of the '8 of 9 audio axes scored by reading strings out of regions.json' defect.

SURVEY-5 (the build already admits it): game/src/harness/api.js:2125 self-declares { what: 'audio', owner: 'RI-AUD01..03 / wave-1 piece W1-25', surfaced_as: 'audioMB: 0. RI-AUD02 is unmeasurable in this piece and scores 0, fail-closed' }. Owner attribution there is stale (W1-25 vs plan's W1-22).

SURVEY-6 (RI-AUD03 B4 names a file tree that does not exist): game/data/audio/ambience/<region>.json -- 0 of 13 present. RI-AUD03 scoring says 'a region with no <region>.json audio file scores 0 for that region'. So today B4 = 0/13 and the item is 0/6.

SURVEY-7 (the consumer slot): Engine._afterStep() (game/src/engine.js:3942) is the one slot every way the world advances passes through (stepFrames, rAF accumulator, walkRoute, walkPath, travelRide), and it is OUTSIDE armSim()'s determinism guard. It is where _streamProvince() lives and is the correct home for a non-simulation ambience driver.

SURVEY-8 (region resolution is live): WorldField.regionAt(x,z) / regionIndexAt(x,z) (game/src/world/field.js:216-217) read the terrain.json region raster and are already used by province.js, signature.js and engine.js:2874. Ambience needs no new position model.

SURVEY-9 (the loader drops unclaimed files): loadData() in engine.js ~7150 dispatches index entries through an if/else chain; the code's own comments record that world/opacity.json, dialogue/persuasion-gmst.json and dialogue/faction-reactions.json each spent a round being fetched, counted in the byte total, and DROPPED because they matched no branch -- 'indistinguishable from shipping nothing'. Any audio/ambience/*.json MUST get its own branch.

SURVEY-10 (budget headroom): RI-AUD02 D-table caps the ambience bus at V5 <= 8 concurrent voices; RI-AUD03 bed sits -28..-24 LUFS-S. There is no asset budget problem because there are no assets: a PROCEDURAL bed costs 0 bytes of audio and cannot breach any MB ceiling.

BUILT: 13 beds at 36.9 KB TOTAL for the whole province. One 30 s stereo Vorbis loop is ~500 KB, so a sampled bed for 13 regions is ~6.5 MB. Synthesis makes RI-AUD02's byte budget a non-issue; audioMB stays 0 and is now accompanied by audioSynthesised/ambienceBeds/ambienceDataKB in getWorldStats() so nobody reads `audioMB 0` as `no audio` again.

CORPUS CONTRADICTION FOUND (RI-AUD03 internal): §B gives Western Rootlands' hide-drum 'a 90-second beat' and puts it in the L3 column; §A caps EVERY L3 interval at 8-40 s. They cannot both hold. Resolved by moving the drum to an R7 positional emitter (period_s 90) -- it keeps the exact beat, stops breaking the band, and gains a bearing, which is what §C actually needs from it to separate Western Rootlands from the three other (wet,open,living) regions. Census C4 is what found it.

VOICE BUDGET, correctly modelled: counting all L2 sublayers as concurrent is wrong because R5 makes day and night selections mutually exclusive. Naive counting flagged 3 regions over V5's cap of 8 and would have pushed a builder to DELETE night content to satisfy a cap night content never breaches. maxConcurrentL2() takes the worse of the two time-of-day worlds. Western Rootlands then sits at exactly 8 (L1 1 + L2 2 + L3 2 + L4 2 + drum 1).

CENSUS IS FALSIFIABLE (proved, not asserted): forced all 13 L1s to one asset -> C3 HARD FAIL naming all 13 regions; added a songbird to Thornmarsh -> C5 FAIL 'the standard layer being quietly wired up into the region whose identity is that it has none'; deleted hive.json -> C1 FAIL. All three are RI-AUD03's own named failure modes. Restored, PASS.

FIRST REAL RENDER (6 s/region, 16 kHz): 13/13 regions produce audible PCM (peak 0.095-0.60). G1 driver_followed 13/13 -- Engine._afterStep() -> field.regionAt() -> bed, proved by teleporting into each region and reading getAmbienceState(). G3 separation_proxy 0.974 of 78 pairs. G8 consumption PASS. G6 border PASS.

SABOTAGE CONTROL WORKS: forcing every L1 to one shared synth (RI-AUD03's 'one swamp loop') drops separation_proxy from 0.974 to 0.628. It does not go to 0 because L2/L3/L4 still differ, which is the honest result -- the control isolates L1's contribution, and R2 (unique L1 per region) is measurably ~35% of the province's audible identity.

MIX WAS 11.5 LU OUT: first render measured beds from -14.5 (stone-forest) to -36.7 (stone-wastes) LUFS against targets of -24..-34. Every individual gain_db was plausible; their sum was not. This is RI-AUD03's 'mixed by ear at exploration volume' failure, caught by measurement. Fixed with a per-bed `bed_gain_db` master trim calibrated from the measurement (range +5.74 to -10.97 dB), NOT by loosening the gate.

MY OWN PROBE WAS DEGENERATE: the first emitter transect walked along z = the buoy's own z, so the buoy was exactly abeam for the whole walk and sin(bearing) saturated at +1, stepped to -1, saturated again. The pan MODEL was right and the PROBE was broken. Offsetting the transect 150 m makes the bearing sweep continuously, which is the case a player actually walks.

CALIBRATED 20 s RENDER: 7 of 8 gates PASS. G4_level went 4/13 -> 13/13 after the bed_gain_db trims (every bed now lands within 0.5 LU of its own target; stone-wastes exactly -34.00, hive exactly -25.00). G3 separation_proxy 0.987 of 78 pairs. Control still collapses to 0.641.

MY PROBE WAS WRONG A SECOND TIME: G7 failed with zero_crossings=2 while the transect data was textbook-perfect (pan +0.894 -> exactly 0 -> -0.894, strictly monotonic, gain peaking at closest approach, silent past 600 m). Math.sign() over an exact zero counts +1->0 and 0->-1 as two sign changes. Fixed to a strict sign-product plus an exact-zero count. Twice in one piece the instrument was red and the model was right -- worth flagging to a critic, because the reverse (instrument green, model wrong) is the failure this project keeps paying for.

20 s CLIPS OFTEN CONTAIN NO L3/L4 AT ALL: with L3 at 8-40 s and L4 at 45-180 s, the measured event count per 20 s clip was 0 or 1 across all 13 regions. RI-AUD03 §C's blind test uses 20 s clips, so B1/B2 will in practice be decided almost entirely by L1 and L2 -- the signature one-shots the item leans on for its four (wet,open,living) regions may simply not be in the clip. A critic running B1/B2 should either lengthen the clip or seed the capture so the signature event is guaranteed present. This is a real weakness in the item's own method, found by rendering it.

LIVE PATH WIRED: game/src/main.js opens an AudioContext on the first real gesture in PLAY mode only (browsers block audio before a gesture; a context made at boot starts suspended and stays silent, which is the version that looks right in code and makes no sound). Automated runs are excluded -- --mute-audio is in DETERMINISTIC_CHROMIUM_ARGS and all measurement goes through OfflineAudioContext.

RI-WLD04 M18's AUDIO AXIS IS MEASURABLE AGAIN, AND IT BITES. tools/world/region-axes.mjs dropped it with the note 'getWorldStats() reports audioMB 0. There is no audio in this build at all' -- verdict W1-01 §4d had called it 'the sharpest illustration' of scoring strings (78/78 pairs differing on a build with no audio). It now scores 77/78 off the level-normalised spectrum of PCM the engine rendered. The axis fails OPEN: with no reports/w1-22/ambience-spectra.json the tool behaves exactly as before, so no other agent's run can be broken by it.

THE ONE PAIR THAT DID NOT SEPARATE: salt-hills / valus-ridge, spectral distance 0.086 against a 0.15 floor -- the only sub-floor pair of 78. Both are dry open wind regions and Valus Ridge's tonal rock-flute chord (RI-AUD03 §B: 'the only tonal L1 with defined notes', D3 F3 A3 C4) was buried under its own high altitude-wind L2, so both regions read as broadband wind. Fixed by raising L1 4 dB and dropping L2 6 dB -- a tonal L1 nobody can hear is not a tonal L1. Next-closest pairs (deep-marshes/stone-wastes 0.166, marauders-coast/salt-hills 0.174) are the ones a critic should watch.

CONTENTION LOG: the box ran 12-30 concurrent headless_shell with loadavg 8.7-21.8 throughout the browser phase. A 20 s x 13-region render took over ten minutes on the first attempt. Transport was the cost, not the synthesis: 20 s stereo at 16 kHz is 640,000 doubles per region across the CDP bridge, so ambienceCapture() now returns base64 16-bit PCM by default (--arrays restores the old form). Counts, ratios and spectra in this piece are contention-proof; no wall-clock figure here should be treated as anything but an upper bound.

tools/blind/audio-pack.mjs USED audioMB===0 AS ITS ABSENCE MARKER. That marker is now permanently wrong in the other direction: the bed is synthesised so audioMB is 0 forever, and the tool would have reported ABSENT over a province making thirteen distinct sounds. Rewired to read getAmbienceState().beds_loaded. Any tool keying on audioMB has the same bug -- tools/world/region-axes.mjs was the other one.

SEAM WITH W1-11 IS CLEAN: W1-11 is building game/src/audio/impact-audio.js in the same directory concurrently. Its engine import comment states it 'touches nothing of W1-22's ambience path', and the two drivers are separate objects (engine.ambience vs engine.impactAudio) with separate harness surfaces. W1-11 also removed my now-stale 'no combat impact audio' line from getUnimplemented, correctly.

PER-FRAME COST: _stepAmbience() runs on every frame of every probe in the project. Made allocation-free -- the emitter array and the step() argument object are both reused rather than rebuilt per frame, and nine of thirteen regions have no emitter at all. LayerClock.due() early-exits when nothing is scheduled and returns [] immediately for a null layer, so R1's null layers cost nothing.

SUCCESSOR-1: the predecessor's --calibrate run DID complete before the restart. reports/w1-22/ambience-render.json is 9/9 gates PASS at 20 s, and the valus-ridge/salt-hills pair that sat at 0.086 now clears: G3 separation_proxy is 1.000 — ALL 78 of 78 pairs separate, up from 0.974/0.987. Control still collapses to 0.628. Nothing in next_step needed redoing.

SUCCESSOR-2 (gap I closed): NONE of the four reports/w1-22/*.json carried a commit stamp, which AGENT-PROTOCOL requires ('a measurement is a claim about a commit'). Added taken_at + git{commit,dirty} to ambience-render.json and to the ambience-spectra.json sidecar.

SUCCESSOR-3 (the defect one level up): the spectra sidecar could silently outlive the beds. Someone retunes a bed, never re-renders, and region-axes.mjs goes on scoring RI-WLD04 M18's audio axis off PCM the engine no longer makes — the SAME 'scored against a declaration, not the world' defect this piece exists to kill, just moved up a level. Sidecar now carries beds_digest (sha256 over the 13 bed files); region-axes compares and WARNS. Reported, never enforced: it stays fail-open because every other agent runs region-axes and none of them owns the audio.

SUCCESSOR-4 (event-vocabulary outage check, clean): AmbienceDriver._emit() (game/src/audio/ambience.js:270) pushes ONLY to its own bounded this.log array. It never touches the closed vocabulary in game/src/sim/events.js. The failure mode that took the whole project down — sim/environment.js emitting day_phase/weather_change with no vocabulary entry, throwing inside the fixed step and killing every stepping probe — cannot occur here. Verified by grep: no import of events.js anywhere in game/src/audio/.
SUCCESSOR-5: check-data (545 files), check-quests (120 quests), check-content (383 resolutions) and boot-check all PASS at 0b2d6ef.
